answer: Bind each earning seat to a non-transferable, slowly-maturing stake anchored to a scarce external resource: a cedar that needs seasons to grow, not a weed. Each epoch the network emits an unpredictable liveness pulse; a seat must answer it inside a tight window with its anchor-bound key, and rewards unlock only after many consecutive answered pulses. Honest nodes earn a steady violet trust signal over time, so a sybil farm must fund, anchor, and keep awake a separate seat per fake, making cost scale linearly per head while an honest agent pays once.
